thread:
Maria Chen: quick heads-up — PR #50222 is blocked by CI, mac-smoke and windows-embed keep failing with snapshot diffs. planning to ship after the merge window today, need eyes. :eyes:
Ben Ortiz: can you paste the failing test names/log snippet?
Maria Chen: sure — failing tests: `render/macos/smoke_render.test` and `embed/indexer_windows.test`
Maria Chen: log snippet:
```
--- FAIL: render/macos/smoke_render.test
  expected snapshot mismatch in frame_12.png
--- FAIL: embed/indexer_windows.test
  Index size changed from 4096 to 4092 (non-deterministic?)
```
Priya Nair: hmm odd. both are flaky historically. did anything change in the PR that touches rendering or quantization?
Oliver K: the PR touches chunked-kv-commit ordering (small reorder), could affect determinism. not sure about windows serializer though.
Ben Ortiz: my vote is targeted rerun on the two failing shards first (don't waste full matrix). if green twice, we can consider merge with snapshot update if the diff is intentional.
Maria Chen: running targeted rerun now: `bk buildkite-agent pipeline upload --pipeline pr-50222-targeted`
CI Bot: rebuild queued for pr-50222 (targeted: mac-smoke, windows-embed) — build #1103
Maria Chen: tagging @Priya and @Ben for approvals after rerun
QA Bot: mac-smoke (shard 7) — run #1103 failed (same snapshot diff)
Ben Ortiz: ugh same diff. can you attach the image diff?
Maria Chen: attaching diff link: https://ci.redwood/test-diffs/pr-50222/1103/frame_12.diff.png
Priya Nair: looking — this looks like minor font fallback shift, probably not intentionally from this PR. but the indexer change in the PR could correlate.
Oliver K: suggestion: add deterministic RNG seed where KV compaction touches ordering, quick patch in PR to set seed for the embed indexer. low-risk.
Maria Chen: I can push hotfix commit to PR branch, but that'll retrigger full CI. can we do a canary: push to branch and rerun only those shards again?
Ben Ortiz: yes do that. also please add a short note in PR describing the nondet hypothesis so reviewers know.
Maria Chen: pushed commit `ci/deterministic-seed-50222`, starting targeted rerun again
CI Bot: rebuild queued for pr-50222 (targeted: mac-smoke, windows-embed) — build #1104
QA Bot: mac-smoke (shard 7) — run #1104 passed
QA Bot: windows-embed (shard 3) — run #1104 flaky-pass (index size 4096)
Priya Nair: nice. one green, one flaky-pass. I'd like one more clean run before approving. can we get a second confirmation?
Maria Chen: kicked one more targeted run (1105)
CI Bot: rebuild queued for pr-50222 (targeted: mac-smoke, windows-embed) — build #1105
QA Bot: mac-smoke — run #1105 passed
QA Bot: windows-embed — run #1105 passed
Ben Ortiz: looks good. Priya, can you +1 the PR now? I can take the merge slot at 17:00 UTC if approvals are in. :thumbsup:
Priya Nair: giving +1. leaving a note to re-evaluate if we see further nondet in the next week.
Maria Chen: thanks all. holding merge until 17:00 UTC window and then I'll merge. adding a follow-up ticket to track nondeterminism and add regression tests.
Oliver K: thanks for the quick turn. logging the hypothesis in the ticket: KV commit ordering -> nondet snapshots.
Ben Ortiz: if retries crop up again we should consider auto-targeted-rerun policy for known-flaky shards.
Maria Chen: noted. closing loop here. :white_check_mark:
